slots.jd.residential-builder.about:
About us and the job
Elmcrest Builders is an owner-run residential builder in Boise, Idaho. We build homes and stand behind our work. We are looking for a Project Manager who wants to be on site, not behind a desk. You will run jobs from permit to handover, work closely with our crews and trade partners, and keep homeowners informed along the way. This is an on-site role.
slots.jd.residential-builder.duties:
What the job involves
- Apply for permits and schedule inspections so each phase of the build can move ahead on time
- Run regular meetings with homeowners to review progress, decisions and upcoming work
- Coordinate subcontractors and set the order in which trades come on site
- Walk the site often to check quality, safety and progress
- Keep schedules, budgets and job records current and share updates with the owners of the business
slots.jd.residential-builder.needs:
What you need
- 4 or more years of experience managing construction projects, including contract administration and punch list closeout
- Working knowledge of Oracle Primavera for building and updating schedules
- Daily use of Procore and Bluebeam Revu for documents, submittals and drawing markups
- Safety planning experience on active residential job sites
- Construction Safety Manager Certificate (required)
slots.r1.b1: Schedules permit applications and city inspections around safety planning for each build phase, cutting inspection reschedules by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Coordinates subcontractor crews and trade sequencing in Oracle Primavera so each trade arrives when the site is ready for its work.
slots.r1.b3: Reviews submittals against budget lines with cost tracking, reducing unplanned material costs by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Leads site safety walks and turns hazards that need extra work into scoped change orders when corrective work falls outside the contract.
slots.r1.i1: Manages construction projects at Meridian Cross, with responsibility for reviewing submittals before materials are ordered and installed.
slots.r1.i2: Manages project budgets and schedules at Meridian Cross, tracking costs and dates from the start of each job through completion.
slots.r2.b1: Ran owner meetings with permit management updates on every agenda, raising on-time permit approvals by 55 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Tracked project budgets and schedules alongside submittal tracking logs, flagging late approvals that put dates or costs at risk.
slots.r2.b3: Priced change orders from marked-up drawings in Bluebeam Revu, shortening pricing turnaround by 25 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Scheduled permit applications and inspections in Procore, keeping crews, inspectors and the superintendent on the same calendar.
slots.r2.i1: Supported project managers at Tillman Brothers by tracking budgets and schedules across active construction projects.
slots.r2.i2: Priced change orders at Tillman Brothers, gathering subcontractor quotes and preparing cost backup for owner review.
slots.summary.1: Construction project manager with about 4 years of experience owning permit and submittal processes from first request to final approval. Uses permit management, submittal tracking and Bluebeam Revu to keep reviews moving and projects on schedule.
slots.summary.2: Construction project management specialist with 4 years of experience running recurring processes from request to completion on active job sites. Brings permit management, submittal tracking and Bluebeam Revu markup work, backed by a B.S. in Construction Management and a Construction Safety Manager Certificate.
